policy: Korean is canonical. English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Tagalog, Indonesian, Russian, French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are active display languages with full UI packs. Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) is a display variant of zh-CN: the UI renders the zh-CN pack and assets/js/zh-traditional.js converts the displayed text to Traditional (OpenCC s2t), so it has no separate pack. Official legal, immigration, agency, and document terms must be resolved through data/i18n/official-terms.json when available; the glossary is maintained for en and zh-CN, and unverified official names render the Korean canonical for every other locale.
notes: Korean canonical; en/zh-CN/ja/vi/tl/id/ru/fr/es/ar/de are full display packs. zh-TW is a runtime Traditional conversion of zh-CN. Remaining pendingLocales fall back to Korean until validated packs are added.
